faq.title: Your Shared Web Hosting Questions Answered

items.a: Shared hosting is ideal for individuals, small businesses, or startups with low to moderate traffic. It's perfect for personal blogs, portfolio sites, and small e-commerce stores.

items.q: What are the limitations of shared hosting?
items.a: Because resources are shared with other users on the server, high traffic spikes or resource-intensive operations might be slightly constrained compared to a VPS or Dedicated server.
Yes! All our shared hosting plans include Free SSL certificates, malware scanning, and advanced security configurations to ensure your data stays safe.

items.q: Will my website's performance be affected by other sites?
items.a: Yes, since resources are shared, the performance of your website can be impacted by traffic spikes or issues with other sites on the same server. However, CloudLinux ensures strict resource isolation.

items.q: Is website migration free when a customer purchases shared hosting from 1OnlyHost?
items.a: Yes, our team provides free, seamless website migration assistance when you move your website to our shared hosting plans.

items.q: What is the Estimated Setup Time for My Web Hosting Upon Placing an Order Today?
items.a: Your account is set up instantly upon successful payment. You can start building or migrating your website within minutes.

items.q: Is shared hosting suitable for e-commerce sites?
